card.name: Boxed-warning sentences on antidepressant and antipsychotic risk
card.fires_on: Two spots in boxed-warning text: the digit 4 ending 'age 24' in the antidepressant suicidality statement, and 'suggest' after 'Observational studies' in the antipsychotic dementia-mortality warning.

modes.label: Age 24 cutoff
modes.description: The final digit of the age 24 in the statement about suicidality with antidepressants in adults.
modes.example: in adults beyond age 2<<4>>; there was a reduction with antidepressants

modes.label: Observational studies suggest
modes.description: The verb 'suggest' after 'Observational studies' in the dementia-related mortality warning.
modes.example: Observational studies<< suggest>> that, similar to atypical antips

card.plain: It lights up on a few fixed spots in standard psychiatric drug warnings, such as the age 24 cutoff and 'observational studies suggest'.
